_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Secrets go in the environment, never here.
_accounts_note: One file can hold several mailboxes. Settings at this level are shared by all of them; each block under 'accounts' overrides only what differs. Pick one with --account NAME, or JOBTRACKER_ACCOUNT. Delete the accounts block to configure a single mailbox the flat way (source/imap_user at this level) - that still works.

outlook._note: Microsoft Graph. See docs/outlook-setup.md for the app registration.

_data_dir_note: Each account reads and writes data/<account name> unless it sets data_dir. Setting data_dir at the shared level above would point every account at one store and merge their histories - don't.
